questions.question: Whom does Psalm 41 call blessed?
options: The one who keeps the Sabbath
The one who pays his vows
The one who fasts in secret
The one who considers the poor
questions.answer: The one who considers the poor

questions.question: What does David say his close friend did?
options: Slandered his good name throughout the land
Lifted his heel against him (betrayed him)
Forgot the kindness he had shown
Plundered his house in the night
questions.answer: Lifted his heel against him (betrayed him)

questions.question: The psalm ends with a doxology blessing the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
Blessed is the one who considers the _____.
As for me, I said, 'O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have _____ against you.'
